summary: Mountable guided setup/help: eight local topics (notes, tasks, capsules, dictation, streaming, local models, privacy, motion/3D) with short tours, a checklist whose statuses come only from passed capabilities, API features, settings, key status and saved counts, plus a local/model/cloud explainer, re-check flow and validated checklist backup/import.
behaviour: Unavailable, blocked or unchecked topics are never counted as done; a manual 'done' mark is refused by the reducer and ignored if the feature later becomes unusable.
Capability/feature results older than 10 minutes, future-dated or errored are treated as unknown, never as available.
Streaming requires the 'chat-streaming' feature and a ready route (local-llm for offline; model name + saved key for online); no fallback is implied.
Local models are done only from the live 'local-llm' capability; missing Ollama is 'needs attention' with no automatic download.
onNavigate/onAction fire only from explicit controls; rendering calls nothing.
Only the non-sensitive checklist preference is persisted (usePref key guidance.v1); stored data is validated with a visible notice, imports are size-capped and refused whole on any problem.
Keyboard: native buttons, roving arrow/Home/End movement in the topic list, aria-current, aria-live tour region; reduced motion disables smooth scrolling.

checks.mutationCheck: allowing a manual mark to pass any status makes the manual-marks test fail (verified, then reverted)

artifacts: control-room/.controlroom/orchestrator/artifacts/jarvis-desktop-99/guided-setup-preview.html (static render with app stylesheets, synthetic status)
limitations: Not mounted: App/nav/Settings are captain-owned; see docs/full-interface.guidance.json for the proposed 'guide' view and wiring.
Status freshness depends on the host passing checkedAt; the component re-renders each minute to age it but does not fetch anything itself.
webgl2 is optional input; without it the 3D fact reads 'Unknown'.
No live Electron/browser screenshot was taken; layout uses existing classes and was checked through static markup only.
Dictation/streaming completion has no observable evidence in app state, so those rely on an explicit user mark while usable.
